text:
jordan: Quick status — hitting a perf regression in the optimize toolkit when using int8 quant + KV cache on rtx-pool. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~240ms after PR #4821. Can owners please triage? tagging @aliya @sam for quant + batching context.
ops-bot: ALERT: perf-regression:optkit: staging-canary | p95 latency > 200ms (link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/AR-5321) :rotating_light:
aliya: seeing the alert, adding a triage card. initial hunch: cache invalidation frequency spiked — possible hash change in the new serializer. will grab a trace.
sam: I ran a quick reproduce locally against the same model + pr diff — memory churn up and more GC stutters with seq_len=512. bench script: `scripts/bench/seq512.sh` shows 2x p95.
mike: is this only in staging/canary or did prod see any signal?
jordan: only staging + canary so far, canary crossed the 2.5% SLO breach threshold at ~10:12 UTC. prod traffic routed to stable pool, untouched.
tess: I can pause the canary rollout and pin to previous model+config. prepping a rollback PR now.
aliya: sharing quick profiler snippet — looks like the cache key normalization got an extra sort() in serialize_keys(); that would explain extra cpu + mem churn.
aliya: ```
# suspected change in PR #4821
def serialize_keys(keys):
    # previous: tuple(keys)
    return '|'.join(keys)  # new code introduced sort() upstream => expensive
```
sam: thanks — on microbench to confirm. Also trying smaller batch sizes to see mitigation. locally, batch_size=8 -> 4 drops p95 by ~30%.
jordan: good. immediate plan: 1) tess rollback canary (now) 2) aliy a to open a perf-trace + revert serialize change if confirmed 3) sam to run microbench matrix (batch sizes, seq len) and post numbers 4) mike to watch dashboards & logs for any spillover. target: rollback complete and canary back to stable within 20m.
tess: rolling back canary now — PR: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/4890 (revert) :arrow_backward:
aliya: will open a follow-up PR to remove the extra sort and add unit test for cache key stability. tagging fix with perf-label.
sam: started bench matrix, posting gist with numbers in ~45m.
mike: monitoring dashboards, no prod impact so far. will escalate if anything changes.
jordan: thanks all. once rollback is confirmed stable, we'll schedule a short postmortem and decide if we need a gating test in CI for cache key performance. :thumbsup:
aliya: on it — will link the perf-trace here when ready.
tess: rollback merged and canary stopped at 10:26 UTC.
sam: microbench initial: batch=8 p95=235ms, batch=4 p95=165ms, batch=2 p95=150ms (seq=512, int8+kv). uploading full matrix.
\jmike: (typo in name) — [ignored]
mike: noted the numbers. looks like reducing batch helps short-term but root cause is serializer.
jordan: final: Aliya - perf PR by EOD; Sam - full bench + recommended safe defaults; Tess - add rollback note to release; Mike - keep watch. I'll create the triage follow-up ticket. Good catch.
aliya: ack
sam: ack
tess: ack
mike: ack
